run_cache_maintenance_job: run the cache maintenance job that backfills datasets and collects metrics from environment config
backfill_all_datasets: backfill all datasets in the cache using storage clients and HuggingFace endpoint credentials
backfill_retryable_errors: backfill only the retryable errors in the cache using storage clients and HuggingFace credentials
collect_queue_and_cache_metrics: collect queue metrics and worker size job counts from the MongoDB queue database
post_discussion_messages: post messages to HuggingFace discussions using a bot token and parquet revision
